rachel_marketing: Quick pingwe're finalizing a short launch post and need validated numbers for two bullets: (1) per-token cost delta quant vs fp16, (2) p95 coldstart. Keep payloads <=128 tokens and single-request UX. Can runtime run a compact spotprobe and hand off a tiny reproducible bundle?

omar_runtime: Yep. We'll do batch=1, concurrency=1, region=us-west1 hosted. Deliverables: p50/p95 CSV, per-1k-token cost calc, raw trace snippets, and a demo tarball (payloads + Docker + run script). ETA: 6 hours.

vishal_bench: Running now. Local reproduction example we'll provide (no autoscaler):
```bash
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:stable /app/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant --endpoint http://localhost:8080/v1/generate --payloads /app/payloads/launch.json --warmup 20 --duration 30 --concurrency 1
```

benchbot: benchmark job 1902468100 queued for rwd-gen4-small-quant (tags: launch, marketing).

vishal_bench: Note: hosted autoscaler can affect first-request numbers. We'll include a one-line caveat you can paste under the metric. Also will attach bench_artifact_id and suggested sales tags in the bundle.

deploy-bot: artifacts uploading -> s3://bench-outputs/marketing/1902468100/ (manifest will be available).

omar_runtime: Uploaded. Link: https://s3.redwood.ai/marketing/1902468100/ . bench_artifact_id: 1902468100. Suggested sales_tags: ["webinar-lead","demo-request","latency-inquiry"]. One-line caveat: "Measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; actual results may vary by workload and deployment mode."

rachel_marketing: Perfect. Can you also include any trace ids for spikes so we can decide whether to call them out?

vishal_bench: Will do. If we see outliers we'll attach trace ids and a 2-line explanation. If nothing unusual, we'll say "no significant outliers observed".

rachel_marketing: Great  thanks team, we'll link the artifact in the post and paste the caveat under the metric. Ping here if anything odd.
